data.text:
B. Selvakumar vs State By Food Safety Officer, Adyar Zone on 6
September, 2024
Author: B.R. Gavai 
Bench: B.R. Gavai  ITEM NO.26 COURT NO.3 SECTION II  S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A  RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS  SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRIMINAL) Diary No(s). 32955/2024  (Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 05-03-2024  in CRLOP No. 3406/2022 passed by the High Court of Judicature at  Madras)
 B. SELVAKUMAR Petitione  VERSUS  STATE BY FOOD SAFETY OFFICER, ADYAR ZONE Responden  ( IA No.196606/2024-CONDONATION OF DELAY IN FILING and IA  No.196602/2024-EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED JUDGMENT  and IA No.196604/2024-EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T. and IA  No.196610/2024-CONDONATION OF DELAY IN REFILING/CURING THE DEFECTS)
 Date : 06-09-2024 This petition was called on for hearing today. 
 CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE B.R. GAVAI  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE K.V. VISWANATHAN  For Petitioner(s) Mr. Vinay Navare, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Ashwin Kumar, Adv.
 Mr. R. Vishnu Kumar, Adv.
 Mr. R. Ilam Paridi, AOR  Mr. Aman Kumar, Adv.
 Ms. Harshita Verma, Adv.
 For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1. Delay condoned. 
2. Issue notice, returnable in four weeks. 
B. Selvakumar vs State By Food Safety Officer, Adyar Zone on 6 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44422048/
1 3. In addition to the usual mode, liberty is granted to the petitioner to serve notice through the Standing Counsel for the respondent/State. 
4. Until further orders, there shall be stay of further proceedings qua the petitioner herein. 
 (NARENDRA PRASAD) (ANJU KAPOOR)
